name: Do or Die
source:
Do or Die is a horror dating sim where the objective is simple: Get to know one of four questionably-stable cuties, go on a nice date with them, and see if you get lucky! However, each of them has a dark side, and your date could take a turn for the sinister with the right (or wrong) choices. Will you survive?

[From [url=https://holdmehurtme.itch.io/do-or-die]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Do or Die》是一款恐怖恋爱模拟游戏，目标很简单：了解四位情绪不太稳定的可爱对象之一，和她来一场愉快的约会，看看会不会有好结果！不过，她们每个人都有阴暗的一面；你的约会可能因某个选择而急转直下。你能活下来吗？

[来源：[url=https://holdmehurtme.itch.io/do-or-die]Itch.io[/url]]
